posts.content: CVE-2026-63116 deepstream 10.1.0-10.1.1: missing rule in RULES_MAP lets authenticated users bypass permissions on PATCH_MULTI ops. CVSS 8.8. Patch under review. Track and update now: https://www.valtersit.com/cve/CVE-2026-63116/ #CVE #infosec #cybersecurity

CVE-2026-63116.description: deepstream is a server that allows clients and backend services to sync data, send messages and make rpcs at scale. From 10.1.0 until 10.1.1, src/services/permission/valve/rules-map.ts omits RECORD_ACTION.PATCH_MULTI from RULES_MAP. When an authenticated user sends a PATCH_MULTI record operation while permission.type is config, getRulesForMessage returns a null rule specification and ConfigPermission.canPerformAction treats the missing specification as an unconditional allow instead of applying RULE_TYPES.WRITE. Any authenticated user can therefore modify arbitrary protected records, corrupt application state, or cause service disruption; deployments using the default permission type none already allow all operations and are not additionally affected. This issue is fixed in version 10.1.1.

CVE-2026-76461.description:
A vulnerability in the email parsing of Cisco AsyncOS Software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

This vulnerability is due to insufficient validation in the email parsing logic. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted email message that contains malicious SQL statements through an affected device. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary SQL statements, leading to command execution with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

A vulnerability in the Advanced Malware Protection (AMP) feature of Cisco Secure Email Gateway could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

This vulnerability is due to improper handling of email attachments when the file reputation service is enabled. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to write arbitrary files and execute commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

posts.content:
🚨 PoC published for a critical GitLab CI/CD remote code execution vulnerability; CVE-2026-97229

PoC: https://github.com/jburgess-r7/CVE-2026-97229-PoC

The flaw is caused by an integer overflow in GitLab's regular expression compiler. A crafted CI/CD configuration combined with a specially formed repository path can corrupt Onigmo regex bytecode and ultimately execute operating system commands as the GitLab git user.

CVSS: 10.0 Critical
Affected: GitLab 19.2 < 19.2.8, 19.3 < 19.3.5, and 19.4 < 19.4.2
Fixed: GitLab 19.2.8, 19.3.5, and 19.4.2

The PoC was validated against GitLab CE 19.4.1 on Linux amd64 and demonstrates command execution through the public CI lint endpoint after the required malicious project setup.

posts.content:
Ivanti Connect Secure Zero-Day Chain Exploited for Root Access

Ivanti patched a zero-day chain (CVE-2026-104935) in its Connect Secure VPN that allowed attackers to gain root access and steal Active Directory credentials.

**If you use Ivanti Connect Secure VPN, this is urgent. Update right away to a fixed version (25.1.1.2, 25.1.3.0, 25.1.3.1 or 22.8R2.5) and run Ivanti's Integrity Checker Tool. Don't rely on a clean result alone, because the attackers hide in memory and erase their tracks. If your VPN was exposed, assume your network is compromised: get a full forensic review, and reset every domain, admin and LAPS password and BitLocker recovery key that could have passed through it.**
#cybersecurity #infosec #attack #activeexploit

A UAF turned RCE

In the #curl 8.23.0 release we shipped a fix for one of the worst vulnerabilities in curl in a long time. We grade it severity HIGH. It is known as CVE-2026-92392 with the title HTTP/2 upload Use-After-Free.

https://daniel.haxx.se/blog/2026/10/14/a-uaf-turned-rce/

CVE-2026-92392.description:
During an upload, curl mishandles HTTP/2 `RST_STREAM` received from the server
(with reason `HTTP_1_1_REQUIRED` or `REFUSED_STREAM`) leading to a use after
free of a `struct Curl_easy` object.

posts.content:
CVE-2026-0322 is an EITW post-auth RCE in PAN-OS management interface.

A remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in the management interface of Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS® software enables an authenticated attacker with network access to execute arbitrary code with root privileges on the firewall.

The security risk posed by this issue is minimized by restricting access to the management interface to only trusted internal IP addresses according to our recommended best practice deployment guidelines.

This issue is applicable to PAN-OS software on PA-Series and VM-Series firewalls and on Panorama (virtual and M-Series).

Cloud NGFW and Prisma® Access are not impacted by this vulnerability.

Very limited exploitation has been observed targeting the Palo Alto Networks management interface.

https://security.paloaltonetworks.com/CVE-2026-0322

When processing an SVG document containing nested XML inclusions (Xincludes) with duplicate entity declarations, a use-after-free error can occur. An attacker could potentially exploit this to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary code.

posts.content:
Critical Ghostscript Flaw Allows Remote Code Execution via PDF Uploads

Artifex Ghostscript versions 9.21 to 10.07.1 contain a critical heap buffer overflow (CVE-2026-39919) that allows unauthenticated remote code execution via crafted PDF uploads. The flaw impacts web platforms like WordPress that use Ghostscript for document processing and thumbnail generation.

**If your servers or websites (including WordPress) create previews or thumbnails from uploaded PDFs, update Ghostscript to version 10.08.0 (or your Linux vendor's patched package) ASAP, and rebuild any containers from updated images. If you can't patch immediately, turn off PDF processing in ImageMagick or stop accepting PDF uploads from anyone you don't trust.**
#cybersecurity #infosec #advisory #vulnerability

CVE-2026-39919.description: Ghostscript before 10.08.0 contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the JPEG 2000 output adapter (base/sjpx_openjpeg.c) that allows attackers to cause memory corruption by supplying a crafted PDF containing a JPEG 2000 image with mismatched component subsampling factors. When image components declare different subsampling values, the non-samescale sub-byte-depth output path allocates a row buffer sized for packed output but writes a full byte per output column regardless of bit depth, overflowing the allocation and corrupting internal chunk-allocator metadata to achieve code execution.

CVE-2026-105740.description: Langflow is a tool for building and deploying AI-powered agents and workflows. Prior to 1.9.0, any authenticated Langflow user can achieve Remote Code Execution (RCE) on the server by adding an MCP server with the "Stdio" transport. The user-supplied command field is passed directly to bash -c "exec {command}" with zero validation, no allowlisting, and no sandboxing. The command executes immediately when the server list is fetched. Additionally, the env field allows arbitrary environment variable injection (e.g., LD_PRELOAD, PATH override). This vulnerability is fixed in 1.9.0.

posts.content: Znuny ≤7.3.6 vulnerable to CRITICAL auth bypass (CVE-2026-93483). Attackers can forge the 'Remote-User' HTTP header to access any account, incl. admins. Avoid HTTPBasicAuth and check vendor guidance. https://radar.offseq.com/threat/in-znuny-through-736-an-attacker-can-bypass-specific-standard-login-procedures-and-gain-unauthorized-0c8a601d6b37802f #OffSeq #Znuny #CVE202693483 #infosec

CVE-2026-93483.description: In Znuny through 7.3.6, an attacker can bypass specific standard login procedures and gain unauthorized access to sensitive system functions by manipulating a specific HTTP request header. Because the application incorrectly trusts this header, an attacker can impersonate any user, including administrators, without requiring a password. This grants full access to confidential data and system controls. More specifically, the HTTPBasicAuth modules for the agent (Kernel::System::Auth::HTTPBasicAuth) and customer (Kernel::System::CustomerAuth::HTTPBasicAuth) interfaces read the username to log in not only from $ENV{REMOTE_USER} (set by the web server after successful authentication), but also, as a fallback, from $ENV{HTTP_REMOTE_USER}, which is populated directly from an attacker-controllable "Remote-User" request header. On systems where HTTPBasicAuth was configured as the authentication backend, this allowed an attacker to log in as any existing user by sending a request with a forged Remote-User header, without providing any credentials.

CVE-2026-108587.description: The 10Web Booster – Website speed optimization, Cache & Page Speed optimizer plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File Upload in all versions up to, and including, 2.34.10 via the compressCustom function. This is due to missing file type validation and extension filtering on the page_id parameter, combined with a world-readable leaked nonce that bypasses authentication checks. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to upload files that may be executable, which makes remote code execution possible. This exploit chain requires obtaining the plugin's REST nonce (tenwebio_rest), which is automatically serialized to a world-readable file under wp-content/uploads/ whenever a bulk optimisation batch pauses; because the nonce is generated in a cron/loopback context with a user ID of 0, it is valid for unauthenticated visitors.

posts.content:
Microsoft Patches 1,411 Vulnerabilities in October 2026 Update Including Actively Exploited Zero-Day

Microsoft's October 2026 Patch Tuesday fixed a record 1,411 vulnerabilities, including 70 critical ones (mostly remote code execution) and three zero-days. The actively exploited zero-day is CVE-2026-96951, a Windows Shell Mark of the Web bypass. A .NET Framework WDAC bypass and a MessagePack-CSharp denial-of-service flaw were publicly disclosed. This month is the final security update for Windows 11 24H2 Home/Pro and Windows 10 Enterprise LTSB 2016.

**Patch the Windows OS first because it has an actively exploited flaw. Next, update .NET Framework on endpoints and servers that depend on Windows Defender Application Control. If you are developing ASP.NET apps, prioritize rebuilding and redeploying anything that ships MessagePack-CSharp, including ASP.NET Core SignalR apps, on version 2.5.303 or 3.1.9. Then work through the 70 critical flaws, starting with the 57 remote code execution bugs on internet-facing and domain-joined systems. Use the Microsoft's new risk cohorts to batch related fixes. Finally, check your fleet for support status: Windows 11 24H2 Home and Pro and Windows 10 Enterprise LTSB 2016 received their last update this month, Windows 11 23H2 Enterprise and Education get their final one on November 10, and Windows Server 2012 and 2012 R2 need manual remediation for the AD FS hardening tied to CVE-2026-56155.**
#cybersecurity #infosec #advisory #vulnerability

Apply the NLnet Labs NSD patch for 4 flaws, including CVE-2026-101341. Each NSD stack overwrite vulnerability risks remote command execution.

#NSD #NLnetLabs #DNS #Cybersecurity #Vulnerability #InfoSec

https://securityonline.info/nsd-stack-overwrite-vulnerability-patched/?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=jetpack_social

CVE-2026-101341.description: Tokens of text in RDATA (of for example TXT records) under 32 bytes are not checked to stay within the space reserved for the RDATA allowing for arbitrary sized out of bound stack writes, including an overwrite of a callback function pointer which is called directly after parse.  Zone files which are written out by NSD itself, such for zones for which the NSD instance is secondary, will not be formatted like this. The zone file must be fed to NSD directly, (but it could come, for example, from an operator controlled provisioning system).

CVE-2026-92150.description: F´ (F Prime) is a framework that enables development and deployment of spaceflight and other embedded software applications. Prior to 4.2.0, Svc::GenericHub fromBufferDriver_handler deserialization is vulnerable because the receive handler uses FW_ASSERT for externally influenced deserialization status and type validation and permits a command payload size subtraction to underflow. When an unauthenticated inter-processor hub peer sends a truncated buffer, an invalid HubType, or a header-only command-dispatch payload, malformed hub traffic aborts or resets the process, causing denial of service. This issue is fixed in version 4.2.0.

🚨 PoC published for a Windows privilege escalation vulnerability involving the Windows Health and Optimized Experiences service; CVE-2026-85884

PoC: https://github.com/Beardhammer/CVE-2026-85884

The issue allows low-privileged code with access to the Windows diagnostics workflow to trigger a trusted ETW event containing an attacker-controlled Lua module path. The LocalSystem whesvc service can then execute that module through WinDiag without properly validating the producer or restricting the module location.

Affected: Windows 11 x64 builds including 26200.8457 and 29617.1000
Impact: Local privilege escalation to SYSTEM

The PoC demonstrates the full chain from a standard non-administrator PowerShell session to execution as NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM.

CVE-2026-85884.description: Missing authentication for critical function in Windows Health and Optimized Experiences Service allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.

posts.content:
🚨 PoC published for a critical unauthenticated Splunk Enterprise remote code execution vulnerability; CVE-2026-76268

PoC: https://github.com/murrez/CVE-2026-76268

The flaw affects the Patroni REST API used by the PostgreSQL sidecar on Splunk Enterprise search head cluster members. Critical configuration operations can be accessed without authentication, allowing an attacker with network access to the Patroni service to modify PostgreSQL configuration and execute operating system commands.

CVSS: 9.8 Critical
Affected: Splunk Enterprise 10.2.0 - 10.2.6 and 10.4.0 - 10.4.2
Fixed: Splunk Enterprise 10.2.7 and 10.4.3

The PoC includes vulnerability checking, Patroni port discovery, multi-target scanning, out-of-band verification, and an exploit mode demonstrating the RCE chain.

CVE-2026-76268.description:
In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.3 and 10.2.7, an unauthenticated user with network access to the Patroni Representational State Transfer (REST) Application Programming Interface (API) on a search head cluster member could execute attacker-controlled operating-system commands. The vulnerability is possible because this interface does not require authentication for critical configuration operations. For more information see Sidecar configuration settings (https://help.splunk.com/en/data-management/splunk-enterprise-admin-manual/10.2/splunk-sidecars/sidecar-configuration-settings) in the Splunk documentation.

Splunk Enterprise versions 10.0.x and 9.4.x are not affected.

Actively Exploited Zimbra Flaw Lets Unauthenticated Attackers Steal Entire Mailbox Content

A critical command injection flaw in Zimbra's SNMP monitoring component (CVE-2026-73570) is under active exploitation. Attackers are stealing mailbox content and credentials.

**If you run a Zimbra mail server, upgrade to version 10.1.20 or later ASAP, The system is actively attacked. If you can't upgrade yet, turn off the optional SNMP monitoring service to close the hole. Because attackers have been actively exploiting this since July, treat any unpatched server that was reachable from the internet as already hacked: check the Jetty web folders for unknown JSP files, change all Zimbra and LDAP passwords, and allow admin access only from trusted internal machines.**
#cybersecurity #infosec #attack #activeexploit
https://beyondmachines.net/event_details/actively-exploited-zimbra-flaw-lets-unauthenticated-attackers-steal-entire-mailbox-content-0-9-v-m-g/gD2P6Ple2L

CVE-2026-73570.description: A remote code execution vulnerability exists in Zimbra Collaboration (ZCS) before 10.1.20 when the optional zimbra-snmp package is installed and SNMP notifications are enabled. Due to improper sanitization of untrusted input during SNMP notification processing, an unauthenticated attacker can send specially crafted SMTP requests that may result in execution of arbitrary operating system commands as the Zimbra user.

F5 patched three NGINX vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-97205, CVE-2026-93479, CVE-2026-15176) rated 9.2 Critical in F5 NGINX Plus and Open Source. Upgrade today.

#NGINX #F5Networks #CVE202697205 #CVE202693479 #CVE202615176 #Cybersecurity #InfoSec

https://securityonline.info/f5-patches-three-critical-nginx-vulnerabilities/?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=jetpack_social

CVE-2026-93479.description:
A vulnerability exists in NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source when a map directive uses regex matching and the root directive or access log format references the map's regex capture variables before referencing the map output variable. Alternatively, the same result could be achieved by using a non-cacheable variable in a string expression under certain conditions. An unauthenticated attacker along with conditions beyond their control can exploit this vulnerability by sending crafted HTTP requests. This may cause a heap buffer overflow in the NGINX worker process leading to a restart. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR.

Impact: 
This vulnerability may allow remote attackers to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) on the NGINX system or to possibly trigger a code execution. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.

Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.

NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source have a vulnerability in the ngx_http_core_module module. When asynchronous file I/O (AIO) is enabled in certain configurations, processing a Server Side Includes (SSI) page containing “include virtual” commands may trigger a Use-After-Free (UAF) in the NGINX worker process. This may cause memory corruption or a worker process crash. Additionally, attackers can execute code on systems with Address Space Layout Randomization (ASLR) disabled or when the attacker can bypass ASLR.

Impact:
This vulnerability may allow remote attackers to cause a denial-of-service (DoS) on the NGINX system, corrupt its memory, or possibly trigger code execution. There is no control plane exposure; this is a data plane issue only.

Technical details and PoC exploit code for CVE-2026-74580 (Vghost), an 8.8-severity Linux vhost vulnerability allowing root LPE and VM escape, are out.

#CVE202674580 #Vghost #LinuxKernel #PrivilegeEscalation #VMEscape #Cybersecurity #InfoSec

https://securityonline.info/vghost-cve-2026-74580-linux-vhost-poc-disclosed/?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=jetpack_social

CVE-2026-74580.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

vhost: reset the vring metadata cache on vring reconfiguration

vq->meta_iotlb[] caches the vhost_iotlb_map that backs each vring
metadata region, and iotlb_access_ok() returns early on a cache hit,
taking the hit as proof that the region has already been validated:

	if (vhost_vq_meta_fetch(vq, addr, len, type))
		return true;

The cache is reset on VHOST_IOTLB_UPDATE and VHOST_IOTLB_INVALIDATE, on
device IOTLB (re)initialisation and on vq reset, but not when
VHOST_SET_VRING_ADDR replaces vq->desc, vq->avail and vq->used, nor when
VHOST_SET_VRING_NUM changes the region sizes.

With a device IOTLB attached both ioctls are accepted while the vq is
live, and neither validates the addresses at ioctl time: vq_access_ok()
and vq_log_used_access_ok() return true early because the addresses are
GIOVAs, deferring validation to prefetch time.  Once the cache has been
populated that deferred validation no longer runs -- vq_meta_prefetch()
hits the stale entry and returns true -- and vhost_vq_meta_fetch() keeps
translating through the old mapping as

	map->addr + addr - map->start

for an address the mapping no longer covers.  vhost_copy_to_user() and
vhost_copy_from_user() consume the result with __copy_to_user() and
__copy_from_user(), which do not check it either, so a subsequent used
ring update or descriptor fetch accesses memory outside the region the
IOTLB actually maps.

Reset the metadata cache whenever the vring is reconfigured, so the new
addresses are pushed back through iotlb_access_ok()'s slow path.

CVE-2026-35029.description:
### Impact

The `/config/update endpoint` does not enforce admin role authorization. A user who is already authenticated into the platform can then use this endpoint to do the following:

  - Modify proxy configuration and environment variables
  - Register custom pass-through endpoint handlers pointing to attacker-controlled Python code, achieving remote code execution
  - Read arbitrary server files by setting UI_LOGO_PATH and fetching via /get_image
  - Take over other priveleged accounts by overwriting UI_USERNAME and UI_PASSWORD environment variables

### Patches

Fixed in v1.83.0. The endpoint now requires `proxy_admin` role.

### Workarounds

Restrict API key distribution. There is no configuration-level workaround.

Any organization running LiteLLM as an AI gateway is at immediate risk of credential compromise and late…

CVE-2026-59823.description:
### Summary
A server-side request forgery in LiteLLM Proxy lets an authenticated caller redirect the
proxy's outbound request to a host of their choosing by smuggling an `api_base` inside the
`user_config` request body, bypassing the existing parameter guard.

### Details
LiteLLM Proxy validates request bodies with `is_request_body_safe`, which blocks the
`api_base` and `base_url` parameters but does not cover `user_config`. The `user_config`
object is used to build the outbound router for a request, so a caller can place an
`api_base` inside it and reach an arbitrary host. The guard only inspected the two
top-level keys, so the same `api_base` nested inside `user_config` was never checked.

Exploitation requires a valid virtual key.

### Impact
An authenticated caller can make the proxy issue server-side requests to internal or
external hosts of their choosing, reaching endpoints the caller cannot otherwise access.

### Affected / Patched
Affected: `<= 1.83.8`
Patched: `1.83.9`

### Remediation
Upgrade to 1.83.9 or later (released 2026-04-17).

posts.content:
Adobe releases October 2026 patches for multiple products

Adobe's October 2026 security updates fix critical, high and medium vulnerabilities across eleven product families. The most severe (several rated CVSS 10.0) in ColdFusion, Adobe Commerce/Magento and Experience Manager. Adobe reports no known exploits in the wild but urges urgent updating. Commerce/Magento customers must also apply the separate September 7 hotfix for CVE-2026-75650.

**If you run Adobe products, review the advisory. Prioritize ColdFusion, Adobe Commerce or Magento Open Source, or Adobe Experience Manager, update them first. Each received fixes for critical flaws with a CVSS score of 10.0. In Commerce, CVE-2026-103849 is the same weakness type as last month's actively exploited CVE-2026-75650, so also confirm that the September hotfix for CVE-2026-75650 is installed, since Adobe requires it in addition to this update. Update the Content Credentials SDK components (Rust SDK, C2PA Tool, and JS SDK), which contain network-reachable flaws that could lead to security feature bypass and application denial-of-service. Then update Photoshop, FrameMaker, Dimension, Substance 3D Stager, Substance 3D Designer, Substance 3D Sampler, and Bridge. If you can't update right away, restrict network access to ColdFusion, Commerce, and Experience Manager servers, and avoid opening untrusted files in Photoshop, FrameMaker, Dimension, Substance 3D Stager, Substance 3D Designer, Substance 3D Sampler, and Bridge until patches are applied.**

posts.content: CVE-2026-104748: CRITICAL privilege escalation in SimpleForm WordPress plugin (<=3.10.0). Unauth users can gain admin via exposed AJAX and weak nonce. Disable/limit access until patched. Full details: https://radar.offseq.com/threat/cve-2026-104748-cwe-269-improper-privilege-management-in-wpazleen-simpleform-form-maker-to-chat-apps-e30303ee252058a1 #OffSeq #WordPress #PrivilegeEscalation #CVE2026104748

CVE-2026-104748.description: The SimpleForm – Form Maker to Chat Apps with Quiz, Poll and Multi Lead Notifications plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 3.10.0 This is due to the `wp_ajax_nopriv_simpleform_wp_register` AJAX action lacking any capability check for role assignment and the `save_custom_fields_to_user_meta()` function using an exclusion list that omits `wp_capabilities`, combined with `get_form_settings()` returning a hard-coded defaults array that unconditionally enables meta writing regardless of the supplied `form_id`. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to create a new Administrator-level WordPress account by supplying `wp_capabilities[administrator]=1` alongside standard registration fields. The nonce required by the endpoint is publicly emitted into the `front_end_data` JavaScript object on every front-end page via `wp_enqueue_scripts`, making it trivially obtainable by any unauthenticated visitor before submitting the malicious request.

Microsoft Patches 1,411 Vulnerabilities in October 2026 Update Including Actively Exploited Zero-Day

Microsoft's October 2026 Patch Tuesday fixed a record 1,411 vulnerabilities, including 70 critical ones (mostly remote code execution) and three zero-days. The actively exploited zero-day is CVE-2026-96951, a Windows Shell Mark of the Web bypass. A .NET Framework WDAC bypass and a MessagePack-CSharp denial-of-service flaw were publicly disclosed. This month is the final security update for Windows 11 24H2 Home/Pro and Windows 10 Enterprise LTSB 2016.

**Patch the Windows OS first because it has an actively exploited flaw. Next, update .NET Framework on endpoints and servers that depend on Windows Defender Application Control. If you are developing ASP.NET apps, prioritize rebuilding and redeploying anything that ships MessagePack-CSharp, including ASP.NET Core SignalR apps, on version 2.5.303 or 3.1.9. Then work through the 70 critical flaws, starting with the 57 remote code execution bugs on internet-facing and domain-joined systems. Use the Microsoft's new risk cohorts to batch related fixes. Finally, check your fleet for support status: Windows 11 24H2 Home and Pro and Windows 10 Enterprise LTSB 2016 received their last update this month, Windows 11 23H2 Enterprise and Education get their final one on November 10, and Windows Server 2012 and 2012 R2 need manual remediation for the AD FS hardening tied to CVE-2026-56155.**

A critical Bricksforge WordPress plugin vulnerability (CVE-2026-85097) is being actively exploited to upload PHP files. Update to version 3.1.8.10 immediately.

#WordPress #CyberSecurity #Bricksforge #Vulnerability #Malware

https://meterpreter.org/bricksforge-wordpress-plugin-vulnerability/?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=jetpack_social

CVE-2026-85097.description: The Bricksforge plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthenticated arbitrary file upload in versions up to, and including, 3.1.8.9. This is due to insufficient validation of the attacker-controlled URL field in the 'temporaryFileUploads' parameter during form submission. An unauthenticated attacker can first obtain a valid nonce via the bricksforge_regenerate_nonce AJAX endpoint, then upload a GIF/PHP polyglot file to the temporary upload directory where MIME type validation is correctly performed. Subsequently, the attacker can submit a form with a crafted 'temporaryFileUploads' parameter where the server-side file path points to the validated GIF file, but the attacker-controlled url field ends with a .php extension. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to upload and execute arbitrary PHP code on the server.

CVE-2026-110005.description: The `periphery` agent's container-management functionality of Komodo version 2.2.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability. An authenticated low-privileged user with `Execute`, or `Read` plus `Logs`, permission on a managed server can supply shell metacharacters in a container name processed by the `DestroyContainer` or `SearchContainerLog` operations. CVE-2026-104749.description: The Bit integrations – Form Integration, Webhook, Spreadsheets, CRM, LMS & Email Automation plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation via Log Re-execution in all versions up to, and including, 2.10.6 The vulnerability exists because `IntegrationHandler::executeWithCapture()` stores raw, attacker-controlled field values — including `user_pass` and `user_email` — verbatim into `wp_btcbi_log.field_data` on anonymous front-end requests with no capability check, and `LogHandler::reexecute()` feeds that stored payload back through `Flow::execute()` inside the replaying administrator's session without validating the identity that originally produced the data, causing `RegistrationController::updateUser()` to resolve the target user ID to the administrator and write the attacker-supplied password via `wp_update_user()`. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to overwrite the administrator's password and fully take over the administrator account. Exploitation requires that an administrator has configured a flow mapping a user-supplied form field to the `user_pass` parameter of the WP User Registration "Update User" action, and that the administrator subsequently clicks "Re-execute" on the failure log row produced by the anonymous submission from the plugin's log screen.

CVE-2026-77206.description: Libreswan's IKEv2 state machine has a null pointer dereference bug in the EAP handling code for authentication. As a result of inconsistency within the IKEv2 state machine code, this bug can be triggered by any IKEv2 connection, even if EAP is not configured at all. The error is caused by a fall-through where it incorrectly dereferences ike->sa.st_eap which is NULL. A malicious IKE_AUTH packet can trigger this bug, meaning the peer does not need to be authenticated. The bug results in a crash and restart of the pluto daemon. No remote code execution is possible. Continued exploitation can cause a denial of service.

🟠 CVE-2026-77207 - High (7.5)

Libreswan has a null pointer dereference bug in the PKCS#7 handling code for IKE certificate authentication. When libreswan decodes an IKE CERT payload of type CERT_PKCS7_WRAPPED_X509, it guards the PKCS#7 blob with SEC_PKCS7ContainsCertsOrCrls() ...

#CVE #vulnerability #infosec #cybersecurity #security #Tenda #patchstack

CVE-2026-77207.description: Libreswan has a null pointer dereference bug in the PKCS#7 handling code for IKE certificate authentication. When libreswan decodes an IKE CERT payload of type CERT_PKCS7_WRAPPED_X509, it guards the PKCS#7 blob with SEC_PKCS7ContainsCertsOrCrls() and then iterates the certificate list with SEC_PKCS7GetCertificateList(). The two NSS APIs disagree on a SignedData that carries a CRL but no certificates: ContainsCertsOrCrls() returns PR_TRUE (there is a CRL), so the guard passes, but GetCertificateList() returns NULL (there are no certificates). This causes libreswan to dereference a null pointer leading to a crash and restart. A malicious IKE_AUTH packet can trigger this bug, meaning the peer does not need to be authenticated. No remote code execution is possible. Continued exploitation can cause a denial of service.

CVE-2026-94453.description: Libreswan's pluto daemon has a use-after-free vulnerability when a client connecting using IKE over TCP closes the connection and another packet (retransmit or malicious) is received for the same tuple. IKE state is retained in memory after the client closes the connection, storing a pointer to iface_endpoint inside ike_sa.sa->st_iface_endpoint. Once this invalid pointer is used, the daemon crashes and restarts. This vulnerability can be triggered before the remote peer has authenticated itself. Continued exploitation can lead to a denial of service. Remote code execution could be possible. The IKE over TCP option is not enabled by default; only configurations that contain listen-tcp=yes are affected.

Censys currently detects 175,838 Internet-exposed AnyDesk hosts on TCP port 7070. This figure represents total AnyDesk exposure on the default direct-connection port, not just vulnerable hosts.

Full Censys ARC advisory, including affected versions, exposure data, and remediation guidance: https://censys.com/advisory/cve-2026-109390/

#CensysARC #AnyDesk #Cybersecurity #VulnerabilityManagement

🚨 PoC released for a Hyperledger FireFly server-side request forgery vulnerability; CVE-2026-82957

PoC: https://github.com/hakaioffsec/CVE-2026-82957

The flaw affects FireFly webhook subscriptions, where a user-controlled webhook URL can be accepted without properly validating the destination host. This can allow the FireFly node to send requests to internal services, private networks, loopback addresses, and cloud metadata endpoints.

CVSS: 8.5 High
Affected: Hyperledger FireFly ≤ 1.5.0

The PoC creates a malicious webhook subscription, triggers a matching event, and verifies that the request originates from the FireFly server itself.

CVE-2026-82957.description: A vulnerability was found in hyperledger-firefly firefly up to 1.4.0. The impacted element is the function ValidateOptions of the file internal/events/webhooks/webhooks.go of the component Webhook Subscription. Performing a manipulation of the argument url results in server-side request forgery. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

posts.content: CVE-2026-82355 Apache Airflow 3.3.0/3.3.1 auth precedence flaw, CVSS 4.2. Bearer tokens ignored, requests run as cookie principal. Patch now. https://www.valtersit.com/cve/CVE-2026-82355/ #CVE #ApacheAirflow #infosec

CVE-2026-82355.description:
When a request to the Airflow core API carries both a session cookie and an explicit `Authorization: Bearer` token, Airflow resolves the caller from the cookie and ignores the bearer token, inverting the intended precedence of bearer over cookie. The request then executes -- and is recorded in the audit log -- as the cookie's principal rather than the identity the client explicitly presented.

Only Apache Airflow 3.3.0 and 3.3.1 are affected. Earlier releases do not contain the code path that caches the cookie-derived user, and are not vulnerable.

Exploiting this requires an attacker to first place a valid session cookie of their own into the victim's browser or client: for example by cookie tossing from a sibling subdomain, through cross-site scripting in a separate application sharing a parent domain, or via a shared workstation. Deployments that host the Airflow UI on a domain shared with other applications are therefore the most exposed; a deployment on a dedicated domain with no co-hosted applications is not reachable this way. The consequence is principal confusion and misattributed audit records rather than a direct privilege escalation.

Users of 3.3.0 or 3.3.1 should upgrade to Apache Airflow 3.3.2 or later, which resolves the caller from the explicitly supplied credential whenever one is present.

CVE-2026-82416.description: FrankenPHP is a modern application server for PHP. Prior to 1.12.5, FrankenPHP worker mode can retain PHP session state between requests when the session extension is loaded as a shared module and is unavailable through HAVE_PHP_SESSION at compile time. In this build configuration, frankenphp_reset_session_state() is compiled out, PS(id) can survive a request boundary, and a subsequent session_start() can ignore the new request's cookie because an identifier is already present. Under concurrent requests, session_id() can therefore return another client's identifier or a stale identifier from a previous request on the same worker thread, causing cross-user session exposure, possible session hijacking, and intermittent logout behavior. Builds with the session extension statically linked, including the official static binaries and Docker images, are not affected. This issue is fixed in version 1.12.5.

CVE-2026-65198.description: Huawei's openUBMC ships a default SNMPv3 USM key that uses one value for both authentication and privacy. An attacker who holds the key (recoverable from the open-source build) can authenticate SNMPv3 to, and decrypt SNMPv3 traffic from, any unit that still carries the shipped key. The build customization `manifest/build/customization/default_password.lua` sets `AuthenticationKey == EncryptionKey == 7df2f29369e3ac3245b2c9d46b67a0ecd055197e41808a34ef325db2f6422581` for the iBMC product build, and the community seed `account/manufacture/default_password.lua` sets both to `7a2f5b86f20233ec7b7bef49643fbf34d86d0cbf6f1f8f5c52d4f30d4536938b`. These are shipped constants, not per-unit values, and they are not rotated by the Administrator password reset, so they survive account provisioning. This is especially dangerous considering that SNMP access is mapped to full device administration privileges, including system reset and firmware upgrades.
